questions.explanation: Plants convert CO₂ and sunlight into glucose and oxygen during photosynthesis.

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria generate most of the cell's ATP through cellular respiration.

questions.question: At what temperature does water boil at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C (212°F) at standard atmospheric pressure (1 atm).

questions.question: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: Adults have 206 bones; babies are born with around 270 that fuse over time.

questions.question: Which planet has the most moons in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Saturn currently holds the record with over 140 confirmed moons as of 2024.
